0022600110.text: The Denver Nuggets (0-1, 9th in the West) host the New Orleans Pelicans (0-1, 8th in the West) in the Nuggets' second game of the 2026-27 season, with Denver 1.5 games back in the Northwest and New Orleans 1 game back in the Southwest. The Nuggets won the 2025-26 season series 3-0, and their most recent meeting was a 122-116 win in New Orleans on January 13, 2026, while no games have been played between the teams yet this season. Julian Strawther is out for Denver with a knee sprain, and Cameron Johnson (ankle sprain) and Spencer Jones (hamstring) are both day-to-day and listed as game-time decisions.
